unit.why: The division is a mosaic of homiletic and ethical excerpts. It covers the end of R. Henekh of Olesko's preface to Lev Sameach on faith in tsaddikim, the souls attached to a tsaddik and the sin of speaking against tsaddikim and rabbis. It then gives passages from other books on fear of the tsaddik and the evil inclination becoming a helper, an anthology entry on the Land of Israel, halakhot on answering Amen and 'barukh hu u-varukh shemo', and an ethical will on shame. The only narrative bits are the Ramban's consolation on seeing the fruitful land, the Zohar's punished scholar and a rebbe's years-long habit of warning his followers; all are illustrative vignettes without a developed plot.
unit.boundary_note: continues the Lev Sameach preface from the previous division; the anthology section on shame continues into the next division
